title: Building Non-Unit Fractions
objective: Build non-unit fractions less than one whole from unit fractions.

problems.text: Complete the number sentence. Estimate to partition each strip equally, write the unit fraction inside each unit, and shade the answer.
Mr. Stevens bought 8 liters of soda for a party. His guests drank 1 liter.

sub_problems.question: What fraction of the soda did his guests drink?
What fraction of the soda was left?

problems.text: Fill in the chart: Total Number of Equal Parts, Total Number of Shaded Equal Parts, Unit Fraction, Fraction Shaded.
